notes.japanese: 竹婦人を撫《な》でながら、
notes.problem: The clause dangles on 'as' and disconnects the stroking from the speech it introduces in the next paragraph.
notes.suggestion: Join the paragraphs: '...wore a dubious look, stroking his bamboo wife as he said:' followed by the p22 speech, so the Japanese ながら linkage survives.
notes.sureness: Certain on the syntax; the paragraph break in the house text created the fragment.

notes.japanese: 内心、こんな横柄な坊主に会つたり何ぞする主人の劉を、莫迦げてゐると思ひ出した。
notes.problem: 'Recalled' turns a present contemptuous judgment into a memory; the Japanese means it occurred to him / he thought.
notes.span: he recalled within himself that his host Liu, who would meet such an arrogant monk, was absurd.
notes.suggestion: And at the same time it struck him inwardly how foolish his host Liu was to meet such an arrogant monk.
notes.sureness: Fairly sure; a check of Taisho と思ひ出した as 'came to think' would settle it.

notes.japanese: 甚、迂濶《うくわつ》なやうに思はれるが
notes.problem: Ennoblement: 'improvident' is managerial and soft where the narrator allows a sly dig at Liu and at schooled people.
notes.suggestion: may seem exceedingly fatuous / crassly heedless — e.g. 'Liu, gone out naked into the blazing sun knowing nothing, may seem grossly fatuous.'
notes.sureness: Fairly sure that improvident is too elegant; the exact pejorative grade could be settled by the desk.

notes.japanese: 顔と云はず体と云はず、上になつてゐる部分の皮膚が
notes.problem: 'Upper parts' mislocates the pain as upper body; the Japanese means the sunward-facing surfaces of the bound lying body.
notes.span: in the skin of the upper parts of him, face or body alike.
notes.suggestion: in the skin of the upward-facing parts of him, face or body alike.
notes.sureness: Sure from the posture — face-up on the ground under the sun; no further check needed.

notes.japanese: 芬々《ふんぷん》たる酒香が、間断なく、劉の鼻を襲つて来る。…その酒香が、一分毎に、益々高くなつて来る
notes.problem: Impoverishment and destroyed repetition: neutral fragrant 酒香 becomes 'rich fumes' then pejorative 'reek', colouring the thirst with disgust.
notes.span: that reek seems to grow stronger with every minute.
notes.suggestion: Keep one neutral term throughout, e.g. 'the rich wine-aroma assails his nose without pause... that aroma seems to grow stronger with every minute.'
notes.sureness: Sure on 芬々たる酒香 as fragrant; keeping the verbal network is what the reading requires.

notes.japanese: 鰌《どぜう》か何かのやうにぬるりと暗い所をぬけ出して
notes.problem: The explicit tactile ぬるりと is dropped, prettifying the climax whose disgust lives in that sequence of similes.
notes.span: all at once it slips like a loach or something out of the dark and flies outwards with force.
notes.suggestion: all at once, slimily, like a loach or something, it slipped out of the dark place and flew outwards with force.
notes.sureness: Certain the adverb is missing; loach alone does not carry it in English.

notes.japanese: 蛮僧が、急に落ちつけてゐた尻を持ち上げて
notes.problem: Drops 'barbarian' where the Japanese keeps 蛮僧, breaking the stable monk-naming at the moment of success.
notes.span: At this the monk abruptly lifts the haunches he had settled
notes.suggestion: At this the barbarian monk abruptly lifts the haunches he had settled
notes.sureness: Certain; a consistency check of 蛮僧 across the chapter settles it.

notes.japanese: 療治の中止を申込むつもりで
notes.problem: 'Beg' makes Liu abject and victim-like; the Japanese is a flat proposal to stop, keeping Liu neither fool nor victim.
notes.span: meaning to beg the monk at his pillow to stop the cure.
notes.suggestion: meaning to ask the monk at his pillow to call off the cure.
notes.sureness: Fairly sure; 申込む is request/propose, not begging.

notes.japanese: 勿体《もつたい》らしくしやがんでゐる。
notes.problem: Ennoblement: 'solemnly' dignifies what is comic-pompous self-importance next to the turkey simile.
notes.span: squats there solemnly, in the posture of a turkey.
notes.suggestion: squats there with ponderous self-importance, in the posture of a turkey.
notes.sureness: Fairly sure on the ironic charge of 勿体らしく; the desk's sense of the tableau will settle the exact word.

data.say: Tableau, interview and ordeal read faithfully in manner, with small losses to naming stability, visceral detail and the narrator's flat digs noted above.
